# Prompt Polisher

> Open-source **Python 3.11+ CLI** that runs a **LangGraph** workflow to compile rough user intents into structured prompts: radar → optional threat gate → routing → compile → critic → deliverables (final prompt, blueprint, DSPy-style sketch). Outputs plain text; use **`--report-json`** or **`--envelope`** / **`--agent`** for structured, agent-friendly JSON. Canonical theory (Chinese) and an English bridge live under `docs/`. **Downstream success and safety depend on your model and system design**, not this tool alone.

## Start here

- [README.md](https://github.com/RimmonXIA/Prompt_Polisher/blob/main/README.md) — Quickstart, badges, architecture diagram, developer setup, **Agents and automation** (CLI protocol, exit codes, envelope schema).

## Theory and scope

- [docs/THEORY.en.md](https://github.com/RimmonXIA/Prompt_Polisher/blob/main/docs/THEORY.en.md) — Short English bridge: claims, non-claims, pipeline aligned with code.
- [docs/THEORY.zh.md](https://github.com/RimmonXIA/Prompt_Polisher/blob/main/docs/THEORY.zh.md) — Canonical long-form theory (diagram notes, theory map, evidence grades, limits, references).
